title: A Saddle for Eight
html:
This quest is not fully written yet. Steps, items or dialogue may be missing.The Tailor can fit a harness so the recovered wolf spider can travel with a rider.

About

Given byTessa Reed
Level25
LengthMedium
KindMount & companion
Quest points1

What you need

  • Spider Silk ×8
  • Wool ×4

Steps

  1. Talk to Tessa Reed to get the quest.
  2. Ask the Binxonia Tailor for a harness inside Binxonia - Tailor
  3. Give the Tailor 8 spider silk (8) - Spider Silk inside Binxonia - Tailor
    Give the Tailor 4 wool (4) - Wool inside Binxonia - Tailor
  4. Let Tessa fit the harness at 886, 60

Rewards

Reward
Gold350
Character XP12,000
Quest points1
UnlocksWolf Spider

What Tessa Reed says

Tailor: Eight legs, and the weight must sit off the injured one. I'll need eight lengths of spider silk and four bundles of wool for padding.

Tailor: You can bring materials you've saved or buy them. I'll do the fitting work here.

Tailor: The silk will hold the load. I'll line the straps with this wool so they don't chafe.

Tailor: The harness is ready. Go back to Tessa at the Trappers' Camp. She knows where the buckles should sit.

Tessa Reed: That strap sits clear of the scar. Let me loosen this buckle a little. There, she can move all eight legs without catching the leather.

Tessa Reed: She's yours to ride now. Keep her fed, and check the straps when you stop. I'll tend the clutches here until I can take them somewhere safe.

Handing it in

"She's yours to ride now. Keep her fed, and check the straps when you stop. I'll tend the clutches here until I can take them somewhere safe."
